# Brali LifeOS

> A local-first personal practice system for turning useful ideas into concrete actions, check-ins, and personal experiments that can be reviewed over time.

Brali's core loop is: choose -> practice -> review. The product combines a public Growth Library with planning, Focus sessions, challenges, check-ins, journals, time logs, and personal metrics so users can try a practice and keep their own record of what happened.

## Preferred entry points

For a human who is new to Brali, start with the Flagship Protocols collection. It intentionally contains one curated, discovery-ready starting protocol for each Life Area rather than exposing the full taxonomy first.

For an AI tool or external application that needs the complete compact discovery-ready set, use the Trusted Protocol Feed. It exposes the action, check-in, Life Area, Growth Zone, keywords, evidence status, and canonical URL without the long article body.

Use the content methodology, flagship dataset, editorial normalization register, evidence index, and review queue when provenance, curation, or editorial maturity matters. The migrated corpus is retained for provenance, so reviewed inherited-claim corrections may be applied before public pages and trust states are generated. Do not infer that a source recorded on a pending entry has been editorially verified.

## Content interpretation

Growth Library entries have explicit evidence states: `reviewed`, `practical`, `pending-review`, or `restricted`. Search indexing is earned: only `reviewed` and `practical` entries are included in the sitemap. `pending-review` and `restricted` entries remain accessible at stable URLs but use `noindex,follow` until the quality bar is met.

The library is a set of starting points for personal practice, not medical diagnosis or treatment guidance.

## Data and privacy

Brali app data is stored locally on the user device. The app includes backup, restore, and export tools. The static website does not use a login, contact form, advertising, or third-party analytics scripts.
